design_description: A sharp and modern navy-blue design with subtle geometric chevron graphics fading across the lower front panel. Bright orange accents on the collar, sleeve cuffs, side piping, and logos create a strong contrast that gives the kit an energetic industrial feel. The overall composition stays clean and professional, with the tonal pattern adding depth without overwhelming the design. Combined with the minimalist back layout, the jersey feels fast, technical, and corporate-modern — almost inspired by engineering or motorsport aesthetics.
